description: Duration-based training workload (minutes), excluding walking unless include_walking=true: rolling ATL 7 days, CTL 42 days, same-day TSB=CTL-ATL and acute/chronic ratio. Not intensity-weighted TSS. Every training row includes trimp_load, trimp_atl, trimp_ctl and trimp_tsb: simple zone TRIMP = sum(zone_seconds[z] * z / 60), with weights [0,1,2,3,4,5] for zones 0–5. TRIMP ATL/CTL use 7/42-day rolling means; TSB=CTL-ATL. max_hr overrides the observed workout maximum. include_trimp=true also returns the legacy trimp object with coverage details. Existing duration fields remain unchanged. TRIMP sums observed zone time; workouts without usable zones contribute zero, so rolling ATL/CTL/TSB remain numeric with incomplete coverage. trimp_coverage, trimp_coverage_7d and trimp_coverage_42d report the fraction of included workout duration with usable HR zones for the day and rolling windows. Covered seconds are capped per workout at its duration; coverage is null when there is no included duration. Missing workout days count as zero; coverage is reported. HRV SDNN and resting HR compared with the preceding 30–60 calendar days, excluding the target date; at least 7 valid daily values required. Includes mean, population SD, absolute/percentage delta and z-score. Maximum 500 total rows; narrow the range if truncated.

include_trimp.description: Include the legacy trimp object with coverage details; flat trimp_* fields are always returned

include_walking.description: Include walking in both duration and zone load; excluded by default

max_hr.description: Maximum HR for TRIMP; otherwise observed workout maximum through to
